messages.text: The generated cases exposed one deterministic numerical issue and one nondeterministic oracle issue. Mean/stddev must use the same online Welford update as Rust’s `streaming-stats`; mode ties are hash-order dependent, like frequency ties, so generated `--everything` runs can disagree across processes without either implementation being semantically wrong. I’m switching the statistics accumulator to Welford, restricting randomized cases to deterministic default stats, and matching the top-level leading/trailing newline distinctions exactly before the final build and completion audit.
